# JSON5 parser conformance fixtures

- Upstream: <https://github.com/json5/json5-tests>
- Revision: `ceb24d4080137d70833f86c25659c1331b80a387`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE.md`.

The `.json` and `.json5` files are expected to parse. The `.js` and `.txt`
files are expected to be rejected as JSON5. `.errorSpec` and `.sample` files
are upstream runner metadata/examples and are not treated as executable cases.
